original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：内阁部长承诺各捐至少一天薪资，协助恢复肿瘤科服务
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克政府周二宣布，部长会议成员将各捐出至少一天薪资，用于支持马普托中央医院肿瘤科服务的恢复。该院肿瘤科周日发生火灾，当时收治的22名患者已及时疏散，无人员伤亡报告。政府发言人称火灾原因调查与损失评估仍在进行，重建费用尚无估算。

location.site: 马普托中央医院肿瘤科
location.raw_text: Oncology Department of Maputo Central Hospital

key_facts.fact: 马普托中央医院肿瘤科周日发生火灾
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The fire broke out on Sunday in the Oncology Department of Maputo Central Hospital, where 22 patients were admitted.

key_facts.fact: 火灾中22名住院患者被及时疏散，无人员伤亡报告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They were evacuated in time, with no casualties reported, according to information released by the Government.

key_facts.fact: 部长会议成员将各捐至少一天薪资支持肿瘤科服务恢复
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Members of the Council of Ministers have decided to donate a minimum of one day’s salary per member in support of efforts to restore oncology services at Maputo Central Hospital

key_facts.fact: 火灾原因调查仍在进行，重建费用尚无估算
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: there is not yet a financial estimate for the reconstruction of the affected services, as the assessment is still at an early stage

uncertainties: 火灾原因尚未查明，调查仍在进行
放疗设备受损程度仍在评估中
